verdict.rationale: Reducto ships a documented CLI, a full REST/async API with OpenAPI spec, job-based async processing with run_job(), webhooks for callback-driven pipelines, and batch queue discounts for bulk automation — all clearly usable in CI/headless pipelines without any UI dependency. This is corroborated by live probes confirming a working OpenAPI spec and CLI docs. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD integration guide (e.g., GitHub Actions example) or independent case study of a customer running it in a CI pipeline.
